༄༅/ /zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag gsal byed bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag gsal byed bzhugs/

na mo gu ru we/ zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor rnams kyi sdom tshig sngar sbyar ba de'i don cung zad dgrol bar bya ste/ dang por rlung bum can kha re bzung*/ sems dpa'i skyil krung bca'/ lag gnyis mnyam bzhag gam pus mo'i steng du bzhag pa dang*/ de las yar drangs te dpyang phrag gam/ khu tshur 'dom 'jal bskor ba sogs ni 'khrul 'khor kun gyi gzhi bca'o/ /dang por rtsa khrus chen mo'am/ rtsa sbyong chen mo ni/ khu tshur <bcangs pa > dpyangs phrag brdab cing*/ mgo bo 'phur mnye/ lag pa 'phur mnye/ ro stod 'phur mnye/ ro smad 'phur mnye/ rkang ba g.yas g.yon rim pas brkyang ba la lag pa gnyis kyis phur mnye dang*/ rkang mgo nas 'jus te 'then bskum bya'o/ /de ltar na 'phur mnye lnga'o/ / <sems skyil > de nas lag pa khu tshur brla bzhag byas/ mgo bo g.yas su lan gsum dang*/ g.yon du lan gsum bskor/ mdun rgyab tu lan gsum dang*/ g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum 'phang*/ gdong g.yas g.yon tu lan gsum gcu/ kha gdangs lce brkyangs/ nywa bzhi lhod kyis klod nas mgo lan gsum sprugs/ de ltar na bskor 'phang gcu sprug ste mgo bo'i 'khrul 'khor bzhi'o/ khu tshur brla dang dpyi'i mtshams su bzhag gru mo 'bur gy-is byas nas/ dpung pa g.yas nang du lan gsum/ phyi ru lan gsum bskor/ de bzhin du g.yon kyang bskor/ de nas gnyis ka dus gcig tu mdun rgyab gnyis la lan gsum gsum bskor/ lag pa g.yas <pa khu tshur mdun nas > mgo la <g.yas > bskor te g.yas phyogs su sor mo brgyangs kyis btang ste sprugs <33gt; de bzhin du g.yon <bskor > la'ang sbyar ba ni/ zhags pa 'phen pa dang*/ <33gt; dpung ba'i thad kar khu tshur <kha phyir bstan > bcas/ phar brgyangs te 'phang dus khu tshur steng phyogs su kha bstan te gcu ba ni/ khu tshur 'phang ba dang*/ <33gt; snying ga'i mdun du thal mo brdabs te/

de rjes g.yon pa'i mthe bong gi tshigs gsum la g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis bzung nas rtsa ba'i tshigs nas rim pas 'then/ sor rtse nas shor tshul gyis lhon sner brdegade bzh-in du sor mo gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre/ de nyid go bzlog ste g.yas kyi sor tshigs dag kyang 'then/ de ltar na dpung pa bskor/ zhags pa 'phen/ khu tshur 'phang*/ sor tshigs 'then pa ste/ lag pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzhi'o/ /lag gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa pus mo g.yas la 'jus te/ ro stod g.yas <bskor 33gt; g.yon <bskor 33gt; du gcud/ de bzhin du g.yon la'ang sbyar/ khu tshur brlar bzhag lag ngar bsrang ste/ ro stod g.yas g.yon du gcu ba dang*/ khu tshur pus mo nas yar bzhar te/ nu steng du sleb pa dang*/ dpyangs phrag brdeb pa mnyam por byed pa lan gsum/ yang khu tshur brkyang la slar nu steng du khu tshur dang*/ lag ngar rtsib logs la brdeg pa lan gsum/ de ltar na gcud pa/ gcu ba/ brdeb pa/ brdeg pa ste/ ro stod kyi 'khrul 'khor bzhi'o/ /lag pa gnyis pus mo la bzhagasgal tshigs bsrangs pa'i ngang nas cung zad sgur te/ lto ba g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum bskor/ yang skyil krung steng nas khu tshur g.yon pas pus mo g.yon pa mnan/ khu tshur g.yas pas pus mo g.yas pa'i steng nas tshur mtho gang tsam brla steng du 'then pa dang*/ ro smad g.yas su drag tu gcud/ zhor la dpung pa'ang g.yas su 'then/ slar yang 'chun btsal te/ khu tshur pus mo'i steng du skyel ba lan gsum/ g.yon la'ang de bzhin du sbyar te srub pa yin te/ 'di la lag ngar gnyis ma gug pa gnad du che'o/ khu tshur gnyis brla'i rtsa ba dang nye ba'i phyi rol sa la btsugs/ 'phong stan dang ma bral zhing pus mo gnyis po re mos kyis bteg nas sta zur gcud pa lan gsum/ <63gt; de nas khu tshur 'dom 'jal gyi mthar g.yas <kyis > rgyu zhabs su lan gsum brdeg cing*/ g.yon : bcu £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡· pas £© drug mdor lan gsum brdegayang de nyid go bzlog go

/de ltar bskor srub gcud brdung ba ste smad kyi 'khrul 'khor bzhi'o/ /lag pa rdo rje brdams pa mgo bo'i steng gi nam mkha' phyar nas phyag rgya <kha phyir bstan > brkyang ba pho bar lan gsum brdeg de bzhin tu gru mo phan tshun la lag pa g.yas g.yon 'jus te lag ngar gnyis skra mtshams su phyar te pho bar lan gsum brdeg de bzhin du dpung pa gnyis la lag pa gnyis bsnol mar 'jus te/ gru mo gnyis brtsegs/ ro stod cung zad sgur/ gru mo mig gi thad tsam du btegs te/ pho bar lan gsum brdeg 'di dag thams cad la pho ba <g.yas g.yon du > bskor zhing mdun tu 'phul thengs re'i steng du phyi nas brdeg pa re yong ba re byed/ de ltar na rdor brdams dang*/ lag ngar dang*/ gru mo brdeg pa'i dbye bas pho ba'i 'khrul 'khor gsum mo/ / <khu tshur brla bzhag > sked pa g.yas g.yon du 'khyog gis byas nas/ phyogs gcig rtsib logs dang sta zur 'byar ba tsam dang*/ phyogs gcig shos sgang : de £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡· gis £© yong ba byas/ rlung kha sbyor yang de phyogs su 'phul te/ g.yas g.yon du gsum gsum/ de bzhin du skyed sgur gy-is dbye bas mdun rgyab tu lan gsum gsum ste/ rked pa'i 'khrul 'khor gcig go /lag pa sar btsugs rkang pa gnyis mdun tu shad kyis brkyangs/ 'phong cung zad brdeb/ lag pa khu tshur 'dom 'jal gyi ngang nas/ rkang sor rnams nas rim gyis 'then/ sor mo 'then pa'i skabs rting pa phyir phul/ sor mo re re bzhin rtse nas shor thabs su song ba'i tshe/ rkang sor bskums shing rkang gshog thur du dgug lcogs na g.yas g.yon mnyam du 'then/ mi lcogs na <lag gnyis bzhag ris kyi > thun re mos la g.yas g.yon re mos kyis snga phyi yod pa bya/ de nas lag pa khu tshur 'phong gi g.yas g.yon du btsugs nas lus bteg pa dang*/ rkang pa bskum pa mnyam por yong ba byas te <'phong > brdeb/ <lag gnyis skyed gzer >

de ma thag langs te rlung 'khrab <33gt; bya/ rkang pa brkyang bskum gyis <mdun du > 'phra tshul <333gt; bya/ yang sgur te/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur mdun du btsugs/ kha sbub tu langs te/ rkang pa gnyis re mos kyis 'phra <333gt; 'o/ /rkang ba 'phra tshul thams cad la brkyang ba'i skabs rting pa drag tu brgyangs/ rkang <ma bskum pa'i skabs > sor <mo > bskum dgos/ de ltar na/ sor 'then dang*/ rkang : 'phras gnyis te £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡· 'phra langs 'dug ste/ £© rkang pa'i 'khrul 'khor gsum mo/ / <sems skyil 'beb bya'o3gt; de nas sgal tshigs sa la btsugs te/ yan lag bzhi mnyam du brkyang bskum lan gsum byed pa dang*/ <gcig yang > rgyab 'phar lan gsum ste/ sug bzh-i'i 'khrul 'khor gnyis so// de ltar na lnga tshan gcig bzhi tshan gnyis/ gsum tshan gnyis/ gnyis tshan gcig gcig pu gcig ste rnam grangs sum bcu yin la/ lus thams cad kyi rtsa khrus zhes bya ba ngo bo 'khrul 'khor gcig ste/ yan lag lnga sbyong rgyas pa'o/ /srog rtsol gyi skabs su lus sbyong gzhan ma lcogs na/ 'di tsam gyis kyang chog ste/ 'khrul 'khor 'di ni 'bro lugs kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gdams pa'o/ / ༈ rtsa ba'i lus sbyong nyi shu pa ni/ dang po bca' gzhi'i ngang nas/ lag pa thal mo dang bcas pa mdun du shad kyis brkyangs/ thal mo ma reg tsam gcud/ <steng 'og g.yas g.yon > de nas rdo rje bsdams pas mnye zhing yang gcu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de dang 'dra bar bca' gzhi'i ngang nas lag pa brkyangs/ thal mo brdabs te rdo rje bsdams pa bya/ kha phyir bstan te brkyang la lag pa <g.yas g.yon lan gsum bskor te > gcud/ de ma thag <'di man 'chad > kha nang du bstan brang la gcer zhing lag ngar gyis rtsib logs bsdams pa lan gsum mo/ /gsum pa ni/ khu tshur 'dom 'jal tshur bsdus nas brla g.yas pa'i steng du khu tshur g.yon gyi steng du g.yas pa bzhag lag ngar ma gug pa'i ngang nas mtho gang tsam gyi rgya la g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum bskor/

khu tshur g.yas g.yon spos nas kyang de ltar bya/ de bzhin du <go bzlog nas > g.yon la'ang bya/ bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur brla bzhag 'chun dang bcas pa bya/ de 'phral khu tshur dpyi mgo'i thad kyi sa la btsugs nas/ 'phong dang skyil krung bteg cing*/ skyil krung gi mdun gyen du phyogs par 'chun btsal nas/ 'phong dang sky-il krung mnyam 'bebs su sa la brten pa lan gsum/ lnga pa ni/ bca' gzhi'i ngang nas/ lag pa mdun du brkyang zhing thal mo brdab/ de nas gzhu 'gengs kyi tshul g.yas g.yon tu spel <63gt; mar byed cing lus gcud pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ rdo rje khu tshur pus mo'i steng nas yar bzhar te bzhag <brla sha > sha drag tu brdab/ <dpyangs phrag > lag pa thad kar shugs bskyed de brkyangs/ lag mthil pus mo la brdab pa lan gsum/ bdun pa ni/ pus mo btsugs la/ lag pa g.yas sor mo brkyang ba pus mo nas phrag pa'i bar du yar 'then/ rna ba'i rgyab nas bskor/ 'gram pa g.yas pa'i thad tsam nas shugs bskyed de pus mo'i thad kar 'phangs/ <33gt; 'di skabs rkang pa'ang g.yas pas g.yon pa gnon gyin 'dug de bzhin du g.yon la'ang sbyar <pus mgor langs > / <'di man chad > lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis kar dus gcig tu gong bzhin 'then la/ phrag pa nas brgyud/ spyi bo'i thad du rdor bsdams brkyang la thub tshad du phyar te/ gsang ba'i mdun du brdeg pa lan gsum/ brgyad pa ni/ rdo rje khu tshur kyi mdzub nu ma'i steng du bzhag bar lhu thad kar brgyangs/ g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du gcud pa'i tshul gyis brang dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ gru mo rnams bskyed do/ /dgu pa ni/ bca' gzhi'i steng nas/ snying gar rdo rje khu tshur mdzub sprad de/ mdun du bzhar nas/ lus kha bub bya zhing*/ sa gzhi la khu tshur sleb tshad du phul/ yang tshur drangs la lus bsrang ste/ snying khar sleb pa na/ skyil krung sa gzhi dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas lus gan rkyal du byed pa dang*/

khu tshur yang spyi gtsug gi thad nas phar sa la gang sleb tu brkyangs/ de nas skyil krung bteg cing bsdams nas tsog der <pus mgor > langs te/ de ltar g.yas g.yon <khu tshur brkyang ba > dbus <yar > gsum du bya'o/ /bcu pa ni/ bca' gzh-i'i ngang nas lag pa khu tshur bcangs te/ g.yas g.yon tu drag tu brkyangs/ 'chun dang bcas te re mos su sked pa'i rgyab nas brdung ba'o <63gt; / /'di langs pa'i ngang nas byed pa'i lugs yod kyang skabs 'dir skyil krung gi steng nas bya ste/ bcu tshan dang po sa la bsdad pa'i 'khrul 'khor ro/ /'di man chad <bcu po > thams cad la re re'i mgor langs te rlung 'khrab <33gt; re bya zhing*/ re re'i gzhug tu rlung bsgyur <lag gnyis 'bol steg la btsug rkang mgo gnyis sar btsug nas lus bsreng ste/ lto ba g.yas bskor gcig g.yon bskor gcig steng 'og gi tshul du lan gcig bsgyur ba'o gsungs > re yang bya'o/ /de la bcu gcig pa ni/ langs ma thag lag pa g.yon rgyab dang*/ g.yas mdun nas btang ste/ brla g.yas pa'i rtsa ba nas 'khyud de/ rkang pa g.yon pa sa la btsugs pa 'khrab cing*/ g.yas g.yon tu lan re re bskor/ slar yang de nyid g.yon du go bzlog pa'ang bya/ lag pa thung bas ma thub na/ lag pa g.yon pa mdun nas brla g.yas <g.yon pa nang gi > pa'i phy-i'i phyogs dang*/ g.yon gyi skabs su lag pa g.yon pa brla g.yon pa'i phyi phyogs nas 'khyud pas chog go /bcu gnyis pa ni/ khu tshur dpyi mgo'i steng nas phrag pa'i bar du bzhar zhing*/ de nas lag pa steng du thub tshad du brkyangs nas/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ g.yas <bskor 33gt; g.yon <bskor 33gt; dbus <yar phul > gsum du gcud pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ rting pa g.yas pas rkang gshog g.yon pa mnan/ lag mthil g.yon pa gyen du bstan pa'i steng du g.yas pa'ang gyen du bstan pa sbyar/ gru mo'ang de bzhin du brtsegs/ lag mthil gyi steng du gdong phyogs par byas nas/

sked pa dang*/ stod sgur te 'chun dang bcas te g.yon phyogs su cung zad gcu'o/ /de bzhin du <go bzlog ste > g.yas la'ang sbyar/ bcu bzhi pa ni/ khu tshur nu steng du bzhag gru mo thad kar bsrang*/ gru mo'i rtse mo g.yas dang g.yon dang gnyis ka'i rim pas/ mdun dang rgyab tu lan gsum gsum g.yab/ de'i tshe phrag pa gcud cing dpung pa nas 'khrul 'don par bya'o/ /bco lnga pa ni/ lag pa khu tshur snying gar bsnol/ 'phar zhing rkang pa bgrad/ lag pa sta zur du <sor mo > bgrad cing brkyangs/ <lag pa khu tshur snying ga nas lan gsum mthar > de nyid g.yas g.yon dbus <yar > gsum du 'chun btsal bas shugs bskyed de gcud/ bcu drug pa ni/ <khu tshur snying khar bsnol > rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthil gyis g.yas kyi brla'i rtse mo nas brtsams te/ bol tshigs kyi bar du rkang ngar lan gsum bshud/ de bzhin du g.yon la'ang bya/ 'di la rkang gshog nas lag pa gnyis kyis 'then zhing*/ brla nas rkang ngar bshud pa'i skabs lag pa gnyis kyis rkang ngar gcig shos bshud pa'i lag len yang snang*/ bcu bdun pa ni/ langs te mdun du <rkang bas > 'phra ba lan gsum/ bco brgyad pa ni/ lag pa g.yas pas rkang pa g.yon gyi brla'i nang nas gsang ba'i g.yon du 'khyud/ g.yon pas phyi nang 'khyud de lag sor bsnol <ba yar bshud > rkang pa g.yas pa'ang g.yon gyi phyi nas rkang ngar bsnol te g.yon du sa la btsugs/ <33gt; lus g.yas su gcud/ de bzhin tu g.yas la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /bcu dgu pa ni/ lag pa gnyis thal mo brdabs te/ thal sbyar shin tu brkyang ba gsang ba'i thad nas 'chun dang bcas te sna rtse'i bar du bteg la/ yang thur du thal mo kha phye nas shugs dang bcas te lhod kyis btang ngo*/ /nyi shu pa ni/ lag pa sked gzer byas/ rkang pa g.yas pa mdun du g.yas dang rgyab gsum du 'phra/ g.yon pa'ang mdun dang*/ g.yon dang*/ rgyab gsum du 'phra ste/ re re'ang lan gsum gsum mo/

/de ltar nyi shu po de rnams rim pa de nyid kyis tshar gcig dang*/ lugs la zlog pa'i tshul gyis tshar gcig dang*/ bcu tshan snga < ma dang > phyi <ma > gnyis spel <tshe dang po dang phyi ma'i dang po gnyis spel/ de'i rigs 'gres rlung khug gcig gam mi nus na bca' gzhi bcas rlung gnyis bya'o > nas tshar gcig sogs bya'o/ /༈ yan lag gi 'khrul 'khor gnas kyi sbyang ba'am/ dbang po sbyang ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa ni/ rna ba g.yas g.yon gnyis nas mtheb mdzub kyis 'jus nas/ phyi bskor <33gt; nang bskor <33gt; <de nas sor mo gnyis kyis > mdun rgyab steng 'og tu sprugs pa lan gsum gsum bya ste dang po'o/ / <sems skyil khu tshur brla bzhag dmigs gsal med pa rnams 'dra > mig gnyis g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum bskor zhing*/ steng 'og dang*/ g.yas g.yon du <spel ma > lan gsum gsum blta zhing sgril ba ni gnyis pa'o/ /g.yas kyi sor mo bzhis sna'i rtsa ba mnyes/ mthe bong mdzub mo bkug pas sna bug bsdams te <g.yas g.yon > bskor zhing <333gt; sprug de rjes sna 'phur de bzhin du g.yon pas kyang bya ste gsum pa'o/ /kha gdangs te lce sgril zhing brkyangs la g.yas g.yon

<bskor > dbus <thad gcig > gsum du shugs gcud pa lan gsum ste bzhi pa'o/ /mgo drag tu sprug pa lan gsum bya ste lnga pa'o/ /de bzhin du g.yas g.yon du rna ba dpung pa la reg cing gdong phyir phyogs te gcu ba dang*/ mdun du lan mang du <73gt; bkug ste <mgo > g.yas g.yon du gsum gsum bskor ba ni drug pa'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa spyi gtsug tu brdeg cing spyi bo nas skra mtshams kyi bar <bskor zhing > lan gsum du mnye ba ni bdun pa'o/ /lag pa gnyis <g.yas steng g.yon 'og kha bub tu byas > brtsegs pas ltag pa steng 'og <63gt; g.yas g.yon du lan drug mnye ba ni brgyad pa'o/ /de bzhin du rdo rje bsdams pas mur gong g.yas g.yon gyi mthar thug par dpral ba'i steng 'og phan tshun du 'phur zhing btsur ba ni <63gt; dgu pa'o/ /gong rtsa sbyong gi skabs su bshad pa ltar dpung pa <rnams > bskor ba ni bcu pa'o/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon mchan khung g.yas g.yon du bsnol te/ sor mo lngas mchan khung mnye zhing btsir <bzhin bshud la > ro stod gcud pa ni bcu gcig pa'o/ /de bzhin du nu ma gnyis la'ang sbyar te <bshud pa ni > bcu gnyis pa'o/ /lte ba'i g.yas g.yon nas/ khu tshur gnyis kyi bzung ste <g.yas g.yon du 333gt; bskor zhing*/ nang gi rlung dang bcas bskyod pa ni bcu gsum pa'o/ /kha btsum ste mchu g.yas <33gt; g.yon <33gt; du bskor zhing gcu ba dang*/ kha bgrad cing so bsgrigs la <so > g.yas g.yon du gcud <pa spel ba 63gt; de nas <kha gdang zhing lce brkyang ba 13gt; seng ge'i g.yal byed pa ni bcu bzhi pa'o/ /lkog mas ol mdud mnan te g.yas g.yon dbus <su yar 'then > gsum du gcu/ <mgo > sil li li sprug pa ni bco lnga pa'o/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur mdun du sa la btsugs/ brang g.yas g.yon du gcud cing skyed <mdun du dgye zhing > sgur bya/ yang lag pa rgyab tu btsugs te skyed kyis byas nas g.yas g.yon du gcud/

stegs bu'i steng du sbo bzhag la brdeb pa'am/ nu khar khu tshur brdeg pa'i ha 'don bya ste <snga ma rnams bzhi tshan lta bu dang gong bcu gsum nas bcu drug gi bar rlung khug gcig gis ha 'don byas nas rlung rngub ste 'beb chung > bcu drug pa'o// <khu tshur snying khar bsnol te > langs nas rkang pa bgrad la dpyi mgo g.yas g.yon du gcud pa ni bcu bdun pa'o/ / de nyid las 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum drag tu byed cing*/ <'dom 'jal byas te > 'phong tshos dang gzhug chung khu tshur gyis re mos brdung <ba lan spel ba gnyis bya > ba ni bco brgyad pa'o/ /brla gnyis khu tshur gyis <mang du > brdung zhing bshud <13gt; pa ni bcu dgu pa'o/ /byin pa gnyis la de bzhin du byed pa ni nyi shu pa'o/ /bol gong gnyis la de ltar byed pa ni nyer gcig <langs pa lnga tshan rlung khug gcig > pa'o/ / <bzhengs te > pus mo'i lhang nga gnyis nas lag pas bsdams/ lto ba g.yas <33gt; g.yon <33gt; du drag tu bskor/ 'phong stan la phebs pa brdeb cing rkang ba brkyangs/ yang pus mo nas 'jus lto ba <g.yas skor3 g.yon skor3 yar > bskyod de nyer gnyis pa'o/ / <rkang sor mtheb bcas 'ju bzheng zhing bsdam nas > de nyid dang 'dra ba las lto ba bskyod pa'i tshab tu ha haka ces rlung phy-i la bus shing*/ lus 'dar sil gyis sprugs te nyer gsum pa'o/ / <tshan gnyis rlung khug gcig gam > khu tshur gnyis kyis rgyab kyi sked pa drag tu brdung zhing*/ de rjes mgo lus thams cad lan gcig byug pa ni nyer bzhi pa'o/ / <yar bsnan pa'am rlung khug gcig3gt; bcu bdun pa nas nyer gcig pa'i bar langs pa yin zhing*/ de nas gnyis po langs 'dug gnyis ka dang*/ lhag ma 'dug pa'i 'khrul 'khor ro// nyer gsum pa'i skabs su pus mo nas mi 'ju bar rkang sor gyi rtse nas 'jus na/ na ga <ni rkang sor brgyad dang > ra dang*/ <rkang pa'i mthe bong gnyis > ma ru'i gnas sbyang ba tshang bar 'gyur bas legs sam snyam pa ni kho bo'i rnam par rtog pa'o/

/de ltar na rtsa ba nyi shu dang*/ yan lag nyer bzhi ste bzhi bcu zhe bzhi po de dag ni/ dpal chen rga lo'i man ngag ste/ de'i dngos slob khams pa rdor rgyal dang*/ zhang mtshal pa brtson 'grus grags pa gnyis kyis so sor yi ge mdzad pa'i dus 'khor sbyor drug gi man ngag dang*/ sa skya ba chen po'i kyai rdor sbyor drug gi man ngag ste/ gsum ka khungs mthun pas yan lag drug po'i sngaun 'gro yin pas sngon 'gro nyi shu pa la sogs pa'i ming thogs pa yin gyis/ phyis nā ro chos drug dang*/ lam 'bras kyi dpe bum na'ang rtsa ba'i 'khrul 'khor nyi shu bcug pa ni/ nyer mkho thun tshags bsdus pa yin pa shes par bya'o/ / <rje > phag <mo > gru <pa > nas brgyud pa rga lo'i sbyor drug la sngar bshad bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa'i 'phros la/ dang po rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /zhes pa nas/ nyi shu sor mo'i rtse nas drangs kyi bar 'khrul 'khor yan lag nyi shu da dung yod na'ang*/ bdag gi bla ma dam pa rnams phyag len mi mdzad cing*/ mkhas mchog bu ston chen pos mdzad pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi tho na lus sbyong zhe bzhi'i gzhug tu/ bi bhu ti tsand+ra'i man ngag yin gsungs pa'i/ mgo bo skor zhing mgo bo 'then/ /zhes pa nas/ rlung gi zhags pa 'phen dang lnga/ /zhes pa'i bar khyab byed la sogs pa rlung lnga sbyong ba'i tha snyad mdzad pa yod cing*/ de'i 'phros la/ thams cad mnye zhing steng gsum brkyang*/ /zhes sogs brgyud pa tha dad las byung ba'i 'khrul 'khor thor bu rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa mang rab dang bcas pa yod kyang*/ rtsa sbyong chen mo la sogs pa sngar bshad pa dang*/ da 'chad 'gyur rnams kyi nang du de dag gi gnad rnams phal cher 'dus shing*/ phyag len gyi rgyun ma thob pas 'dir mi 'bri'o/ /༈ yang gnad kyi sbyong ba bcu gnyis pa'am bcu bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje'i skyil krung bca'/ khu tshur 'phong tshos g.yas g.yon thad kyi sa la btsugs/

lus bteg ste <rdo rje skyil krung > g.yas g.yon du gcud cing brdeb pa < 3 > ni dang po'o// rdo rje skyil krung gi sgyid khung <gnyis > nas lag pa btang*/ khu tshur sa la btsugs/ skyil krung bteg cing brdeb pa ni gnyis pa'o/ /de gnyis sdod pa'i 'khrul 'khor ro/ /rkang pa'i mthe bong ngam/ byin pa nas lag pas bzung*/ langs shing 'chun dang bcas pas <'phong dang bcas pa > sa la brdeb pa ni gsum pa'o/ /langs te rting 'khrab <13gt; byas/ khu tshur dpyangs phrag brdeb/ yang <mdun thad du > khu tshur brkyangs/ <rting 'khrab nas > lan gsum <93gt; bya ste bzhi pa'o/ /de gnyis langs pa'i 'khrul 'khor ro/ /rgyab gzhung sa la btsugs te/ lag pa g.yas g.yon khu tshur bcangs nas brkyang bskum byed cing*/ lag pa brkyang ba dang lhan cig < tu3gt; / rkang mthil la sogs la drag tu brdeb <43gt; pa ni lnga pa'o/ /nyal ba'i 'khrul 'khor ro/ /lnga po de rnams re re la'ang rlung kha sbyor du bzung ba'i ngang nas byed pa dang*/ hā ring 'don pa dang*/ ha thung 'don pas byed pa ste/ rlung gnad kyi dbye bas gsum gsum du 'gyur ro/ /de rnams bi bhu ti'i ring brgyud man ngag go /lag pa gnyis rgyab nas bsnol te/ rdo rje skyil krung gi mthe bong g.yas g.yon nas 'then/ lus <yar > skyed cing <mar > srubs la/ thog mar 'phong btsugs te skyil krung brdeb/ de nas skyil krung btsugs la 'phong brdeb ste drug pa'o/ /rkang pa gnyis dpung pa'i rgyab ngos nas ltag par bsnol/ lag pa gnyis brla'i rtsa ba nas mdun du khu tshur bcangs pa rlung kha sbyor g.yas g.yon du 'chun dang bcas pas/ rgyab sa la skyur thabs su 'bebs shing*/ yang g.yas g.yon du gcud nas langs te/ bdun pa'o/ /'di gnyis rgyud kyi dngos bstan las 'byung zhing*/ man ngag brgyud pa thams cad las so/ / <'dir sngar gyi nyi shu pa'i langs ba'i 'khrul 'khor bcu po ma gtogs 'di dag 'dug pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzhin lags/

rlung 'khrab sogs med/> dang por <sems skyil > skyil krung bcas te khu tshur brla'i 'phra mtshams su bzhag rlung pho stod du bsdigs te lto ba tshigs pa la bcer nas <rlung > g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du <thams cad g.yas bskor3gt; lan bdun bdun bskor zhing*/ rlung dgram <de lus thams cad sprugs pa > lan gsum bya/ de nas langs te 'dom 'jal gyi mthar khu tshur gshibs te sa la btsugs/ <khu tshur mdun du phyir bstan > lag ngar gshibs te bsrangs/ gru mo'i steng du pho ba bkal/ rkang pa brkyangs lus bteg ste rlung pho bar <yar > sgril/ mgo rkang re mos su sa la reg par <63gt; bya ste brgyad pa'o/ /sgal tshigs sa la btsugs shing*/ rkang lag bzhi nam mkhar mnyam du 'phang zhing*/ ha zhes drag tu 'don pa lan dgu'i bar du byed pa ni dgu pa'o/ /rkang pa zlum po'i stabs kyis langs/ mthe bong sta zur gyi rgyab dang*/ sor mo bzhis mkhal ma'i mdun 'og nas brdeg rlung phyir bus te/ stod smad chab gcig tu g.yas g.yon du gcud pa ni bcu pa'o/ /rdo rje skyil krung rkang mgo g.yas g.yon brla'i phyi rol tu thon par bya/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i mthe bong <gnyis so sor phral pa'i ngang > gis g.yas g.yon du ska rags 'ching tshul byed cing lus yongs rdzogs g.yas g.yon du lan gsum <63gt; bskor/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis mdun rgyab gang rung du bsnol nas rkang mgo la 'jus/ ltag pa skyed de <g.yas g.yon lus mar > srubs pa ni bcu gcig pa'o/ /bzhi po de dag ni paṇa chen zla mgon gyi man ngag go /dang por snying gar 'khyud rgya byas la <khu tshur > g.yas g.yon du <spel ba 33gt; gcud/ steng gi rlung g.yas g.yon du gnod 'then bya <ba spel ba 63gt; de nas gan skyal du 'dug la rkang pa nywa bzhi bsgrims te brkyang bskum dal bus shugs bskyed de byed cing*/ brkyang pa'i tshe thur sel glod/ bskum pa'i tshe 'then te <33gt; bcu gnyis pa'o/

/'di ni paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa dpyal lugs kyi man ngag go /de ltar bcu gnyis sam/ yang gnyis bsnan pa ni/ langs te rlung 'khrab byas/ 'dom 'jal bskor nas rkang gnyis bar du khru gang bzhagalag pa pus mo la 'jus/ <pus mgo > g.yas g.yon du gcud nas/ <spel ba 63gt; thur du 'bebs pa'i skabs rkang pa ma gug par brla dang byin pa 'phong rnams dus gcig tu bsdeb/ 'di la gling bzhi gcud 'bebs zer te bcu gsum pa'o// lus tsog pu lag pa g.yas g.yon rkang pa'i phyi nas btang ste/ rkang pa'i sgyid khung nas sor mo bzhis 'jus/ rlung kha sbyor drag po dang*/ sked pa skyed sgur g.yas 'then g.yon 'then gyi ngang nas lag pas yar 'then/ rkang pas mar gnon pa <spel ba > ni/ gling bzhi gcud pa zhes bya ste bcu bzhi pa'o/ /phyi ma 'di la 'phong stegs bu'i steng du bzhag rkang mthil gnyis rten med kyi ngang nas gong bzhin byas nas 'chun che bar 'ong*/ 'di gnyis <o rgyan > bsnyen sgrub kyi nang gi de dang phal cher 'dra bas/ de las blangs sam snyam mo/ /de ltar na rtsa sbyong chain mo nas brtsams te/ 'di yan chad la 'khrul 'khor lnga bcu nga dgu yod de/ thams cad kyang srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba lus dag par byed pa dang*/ gegs sel ba dang*/ bogs 'don du 'gyur ba sna tshogs te/ 'di rnams cha tshang bar nyin dang nyin la ma 'chag par byed cing*/ bum pa can la nan tan du bsgrubs na nad rnying pa thams cad 'byang ba dang*/ gsar pa mi skyed par the tshom med cing myong bas grub la/ las kyi lhongs bdo ba yin na ma rtogs/ sgom gegs kyang rnying pa thams cad sel zhing*/ gsar pa mi 'byung ngo*/ /de dag gi bar bar du lus sbyong spyi 'gros la dgos pa'i 'bebs kyi rigs/ skyil krung bcas lag pa pus mo la bkab ste/ 'phong bteg cing brdeb pa dang*/ <rdo rje lag pa khu tshur snying khar bsnol

> skyil krung bcas pa 'phag cing brdeb/ lag pa yang <g.yas g.yon rim pa'i > mgo la bskor zhing sprugs pa dang*/ skyil krung gi ngang nas pus mo btsugs nas ldang ba dang*/ lag pa khu tshur nam mkhar 'phang*/ 'phong sa la brdeb pa dang*/ khu tshur nu steng du brdeb pa ste/ 'bebs chung nyid las phye ba'i chung 'bring chen po gsum yin la/ <rlung khug gcig de lan bdun > de bzhin du 'bebs 'bring po <lag pa khu tshur snying gar bsnol rkang ba > brkyang <ba dang sems skyil gyi > bskum <pa > gnyis dang*/ <rlung khug gcig de 73gt; 'bebs chen po brkyang <sems skyil > bskum <pa rdo rje'i > skyil krung ste/ gsum la'ang bslab bar bya'o// <rlung khug gcig de bdun lta bu'o3gt; de ltar na 'khrul 'khor drug cu re lnga ste/ srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i 'khrid thob pa rnams la bstan par bya'o/ / athi+-i/ na mo gu ru/ rjes dran gyi 'khrid bla ma'i zhal lung dang bcas pa legs par thob na/ 'khrul 'khor 'di rnams kyi lag len tshig gi 'grel pa dang bcas te sbyin par bya ste/ de la dang po sbyor ba drug ldan ni/ bca' gzhi'i ngang nas/ kha bub tu pus mo bskums shing gru mo sa la btsugs/ <13gt; lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur mgul du bsnol/ <23gt; lus nywa bzhi bsgrims/ 'og sgo glod/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer/ <33gt; lce sgril zhing rkan la gtad/ <43gt; ltag pa bsrang stai/ mig gtsug tor du blta/ <53gt; huṃ dang hal <63gt; zhes brjod de sbyor ba drug dang ldan par bya/ <rlung mi bzung > yang de nyid las <rdo rje > skyil krung bcas te/ lag pa <gnyis > rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya sked pa'i thad nas bsdams/ sbyor ba drug po gzhan 'dra ba la/ 'og sgo bsdams shing gsus pa phyir bskyed/ rlung gnad <phyir bzung ba'i > rang 'gags/ sems nam mkha' la yas su gzhug go /gnyis pa stag mo'i skyug stangs ni/ langs te lag pa brgyangs pa'i rje la mdun du mthe bong gnyis gcig gis gcig bzung nas khru gang tsam gyi mdun du btsugs/

rlung thur du bsdigs pa dang mnyam du pus mo dang gru mo 'phrad tsam lag ngar dang*/ ngar gdong gnyis sa la gtad/ de nas ha haka ces rkang lag bsrangs/ rgyab shed 'then/ g.yas <yar de'i ngang nas > g.yon dbus gsum du <ro stod > gcud/ yang hūṃ thung gis brngubs nas khong sgra dang bcas pas kyang gcud/ <g.yas g.yon dbus su rlung > de nas <pus 'dug bzhag gam sems skyil > khu tshur mchan khung du brdeb la haka ces brjod do/ /gsum pa glang po'i 'gying ba ni/ bca' lugs phal cher de dang 'dra ba las/ <langs te sogs gong dang 'dra > lag pa khu tshur mtho gang tsam bar du bzhag pa sa la btsugs/ <rlung thur du bsdigs pa dang mnyam du pus mo dang gru mo 'phrad tsam lag ngar dang*/ ngar gdong sa la btsugs de nas ha haka ces pa la haṃ zhes brjod la3gt; sug bzhi bsrang ba'i skabs gsang rlung khong <hūṃ gi > sgra dang bcas te 'then/ <g.yas g.yon > gcud <glang chen 'gying tshul > pa'i skabs phaṭa <brjod mi dgos > kyi sbyor bas bar rlung brgyangs/ yang gru mo dang pus mo sa la reg tsam byas nas/ lto ba phyir bskyed bzhin

<lag pa g.yas g.yon du > sa la gcud/ slar yang rkang lag bsrangs/ rgyab shed 'then bzhin pas hi hing zhes brjod/bzhi pa ni wa'i bsnom ste/ pus btsugs kyis langs/ khu tshur snying gar bsnol la gru mo cung zad bsrangs/ sna nas hūṃ phra mo <rlung 'bud > dang bcas gru mo <dang po g.yas su 33gt; gcud/ ro stod <g.yas > 'then/ rlung 'bud pa rdzogs mtshams su bsnom pa'i tshul < du > gsum lnga bdun sogs gang rigs bya/ <rlung bzung ba dang 1 de bzhin tu g.yon dang gnyis ka la brkyang > g.yas g.yon dang gnyis ka'i dbye bas gsum mo/ /lnga pa ni seng ge'i rnam rol te/ mthe bos rna ba/ mdzub mos migagung mos sna rnams bkag srin lag dang mthe chung bar du mchu bsdams/ rting pa gcig gis bshang sgo dang*/ gcig shos kyi gsang ba bsdams/ gru mo bsrangs te <dal bus > g.yas bskor g.yon bskor <gnyis lhag > gsum gsum/ <myur bar > gsor ltar sgril ba <g.yas g.yon > lan drug sgo dgu bkag pa btang ste/ i ha zhes sprugs <sgo dgu > brdeb bya/ lag pa gnyis re mos kyis sna bsdams nas yang sprugs <g.yas g.yon > brdeb bya/ drug pa ni dgang sprugs te/ sug bzh-i'i bar du khru gang re yong bar byas te/ pus mo dang khu tshur sa la btsugs/ rlung gsus smad du drag tu bsdigs te/ dpung pa g.yas <13gt; dang g.yon <23gt; dang gnyis ka <33gt; bcag pa'i tshul gyis sprugs thengs re bya zhing*/ de nyid las rkang pa bsrang <zhing > sna dang mchu'i dbus nas rlung bus te hu hu zhes <mgo > sprugs/ bdun pa ni yi dwags pre ta ka ste/ langs bzhin du rlung sprugs byas nas/ rkang pa zlum po'i 'dug stangs dang*/ lag pa 'dom 'jal tshur bsdus te/ gsang ba'i thad nas khu tshur 'chun dang bcas pa thur du 'bebs bzhin du/ 'phong sa la ma reg tsam dang*/ khu tshur sa la phab/ hi hika ces <rgyab > sgur 'then bya/ de nas g.yas g.yon du <rgyab > gcud cing sprugs/ yang drag tu brngubs nas 'chun dang bcas pas langs te/

khu tshur <lag pa tshur bsdus te nas= sa la phab hi hika ces bar gong dang 'dra > gnyis rgyab tu brgyangs/ ltag pa skyed de hi hika ces bya/ lus kyi gnad de ka dang 'dra ba las/ rlung gnad kha sbyor thur tu bsdigs pa kho na'i ngang nas kyang de ltar bya <ste > lan gsum mo/ /de ltar bdun ni/ paṇḍi ta zla ba mgon po nas brgyud pa 'bro lugs kyi man ngag ste/ dang po bzung ba/ de nas gsum bzlog pa/ phyi ma gsum khyab par byed pa'o/ /'di rnams la lag len mi 'dra ba gnyis gda' na'ang*/ 'di 'chun che bas bkod do/ /brgyad pa ni/ <rdo rje > skyil krung khu tshur brla bzhag dgang 'then gyi ngang nas bzhi sprugs byed cing*/ lus thams cad sprugs pa ste 'dren chung ba'o/ /dgu pa ni/ langs te 'dom 'jal gyi mthar lag pa gnyis brla nang nas 'khyud/ rkang sor nas 'then zhing*/ 'phong gyen du bzlog la i <rlung gi sgra gdangs > zhes khong skad phra mo rtsa 'khor lo drug tu drag tu drangs par mos/ mthar mgo skyed la ha zhes 'bud pa ni/ 'dren pa bar pa khong 'dren zhes bya ba'o/ /bcu pa ni/ rkang pa gnyis gshibs pa'i tsog pu'i 'phong stegs can gyi skyil krung las/ <lto ba > dgang <yar > 'then <lto ba > dgang <mar > gnon dang bcas bzhin pa las langs te/ rkang ngar bsrangs/ rkang gshog nas lag pas drag tu 'then/ mgo skyed de hūṃ zhes brjod <bzhin pa'i rlung bzung > de nas rkang pa ma gug par brla dang byin pa 'phong rnams mnyam por brdab ste/ yang rkang gshog nas <g.yas g.yon gnyis nas > gcud cing <yar > 'then la mgo dgug de ma thag hūṃ zhes ltag pa skyed pa ni 'dren che ba'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ langs te rkang pa g.yas pa'i brla'i 'phra 'tshams la rkang pa g.yon pa'i bol gong gtad/ lag pa khu tshur 'dom 'jal las brkyang bskum byed cing lan bdun tsam 'phar zhing g.yas bskor bya/ de nyid du mgo dang*/ rtsib logs/ nu ma/ rgyab dang*/

dpyi dang*/ lto ba rnams khu tshur <gnyis > gyis brdung zhing*/ lus thams cad 'phur mnye byas nas <'phong > sa la 'bebs/ de bzhin du g.yon la'ang bya ste 'phar g.yo zhes bya'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ khung 'dren dang bca' gzhi 'dra ba las/ i dang ha'i ngag 'dren mi byed par rlung dgang zhing 'then pa'i ngang nas bzhi sprugs dang*/ <rkang sor nas > g.yas 'then dang g.yon 'then dbus 'then rnams 'chun dang bcas te byed/ de nas rkang sor bzung ba btang ste <'phong > sa la phab nas/ lus kyi cha thams cad la mnye ba dang*/ 'then pa dang*/ <lag gnyis rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya'i gung mo'i phug tshul lam/ mtheb mdzub gung gsum gyis > zur phug dang*/ thal lcag brdegs pa sogs gang nus bya'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ gan rkyal du gnas pas pus <mo > brang <la > sbyar/ lag pa khu tshur 'phong gi thad du drag tu brkyangs/ rlung kha sbyor rgyu zhabs su phul nas/ <rlung > g.yas g.yon du lan gsum <gsum spel > gcud/ de nas yan lag thams cad brkyang bskum drag tu bya ste/ lag pa g.yas dang rkang pa g.yon dus gcig <33gt; lag pa g.yon dang rkang pa g.yas dus gcig ste/ <33gt; 'di la'ang skyil krung bcas te 'dug nas mnye/ 'then phur zug thal lcag brdeb pa sogs ci nus bya ste/ rab brkyang zhes bya'o/ /de ltar drug las snga ma gsum 'dren dang*/ phyi ma gsum 'grems gtso bor gyur pa ste/ dpe med 'tsho'i gdams ngag ratna rakṣi ta dang*/ shākya shrī nas brgyud pa ci rigs pa ste/ de dag ni bi bhu ti tsand+ra'i lugs ring brgyud do/ /bcu bzhi pa ni/ pho ba sa la btsugs la rlung pho bar rab tu <mnan pa'am > gcud/ yan lag bzhi brkyang bskum <33gt; drag tu bya ste/ seng ge rtsal sprugs so// bco lnga pa ni/ rkang pa mdun du brkyangs/ lag pa g.yas pas rting pa g.yon < pa > nas 'then/ lag pa g.yon gyis dpung pa g.yas pa nas 'then <bzhin pa'i > g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du gcud/

<de nyid g.yon du'ang go bzlog3gt; rlung gnad kyang ma ning dang*/ <bum can bzung bzhin pa'i lto ba phyir bskyed bzhin byed pa ni ma ning dang bum can gnyis sbrags ma yin gsungs3gt; bum can gnyis sbrags byed de gcud 'then zhes bya'o/ /bcu drug pa ni/ skyil krung bcas la lag pa spyi bo'i steng thad du thal mo sbyar/ mgo bo sgril bkug mgrin pa skor/ ro stod sprugs/ sked pa skyogs/ ro smad gcud/ gnas so so'i lus sbyong dang bstun/ thal mo yang de dag tu reg cing gru mo brkyangs te 'chun btsal/ mthar 'phong sa la btsugs/ lus <rgyab tu > cung zad <skyed > skyed nas/ sug bzhi brkyang bskum lan gsum bya/ de nas drag tu sprugs pa ste gsum 'grems so/ /bcu bdun pa ni/ <rlung phyir bsal la nang tu mi rngubs > rkang pa'i brang pa sa la btsugs/ khu tshur gnyis <bsnol nas > dpung par sbyar la gru mo brkyangs/ pus mo gnyis kyang ngang pa'i gshog pa ltar bya/ mgo <pus mo la gtug > bstungs/ lus 'dar thon par byed/ ma ning gi rlung <lto bar > drag tu gtad de/ lus g.yas g.yon du cung zad bsgyur ba ni/ seng ge'i 'gying ngo*/ /bco brgyad pa ni/ rdo rje'i skyil krung byas/ pus mo g.yon la lag pa gnyis bsnol nas 'khyud/ mgo pus mo'i steng du bsgyur <bkug3gt; zhing dpung pa g.yas <pa'i > steng du 'then/ yang de nyid go bzlog pa'ang bya ste rma bya'i 'gyur ro/ /de ltar lnga ni 'dren 'grems bzung ba gsum kar byed pa ste/ tsa mi dang rga lo'i lugs/ gnyos ston 'od ma dang*/ zhang mtshal pa'i man ngag rnams nas zab cing gal che ba rnams blangs pa'o/ /bcu dgu pa ni/ <rdo rje'i skyil krung > khu tshur brla bzhag mgo bo sgur/ 'og rlung yar 'then <rlung phyir bsal la > stong 'dren drag po bya/ <bzhin pa'i ngang > der hūṃ nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bsdud/ de 'phral langs te lag pa gnyis pus mo la bkab nas kyang rlung gnad snga ma de dang 'dra bar bya/

rlung nang du drangs/ mgo bkug ste mchil ma mid la steng rlung mnan pa'i ngang nas 'og rlung rim gyis 'then pa dang ltag pa skyed kyis btang ngo*/ /bsdad nas hūṃ nyer gcig gi skabs dang*/ langs nas hūṃ nyer gcig gi skabs dang*/ ltag pa skyed kyis btang ba gsum po 'di la g.yas g.yon dbus gsum drag tu 'then no/ /de rjes ha thung dang rting 'khrab nyer gcig hā ring dang 'khrab chen nyer gcig bya ste sbags 'dren zhes bya'o/ /nyi shu pa ni/ bca' gzhi'i ngang nas lus sgur/ gru mo <dang > pus mo sa la btsugs te/ steng rlung ha zhes phyir 'bud pa dang mnyam du thur sel bshang sgor bsdigs la glod/ ma ning gi rlung thub tshad du brgyangs/ yang brngubs nas langs te rkang lag bgrad/ ltag pa skyed pa'i ngang nas rlung gi gnad gsum sngar bzhin bya/ yang brngubs ste stan gyi steng du brdeb/ tsog pu'am skyil krung gi ngang nas rlung gi gnad sogs sngar bzhin byed/ de nas gsang rtsa bsdams pa'i 'bebs chung lan gsum las mi nyung ba bya ste yongs 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /de ltar gnyis las snga ma 'dren 'grems sbrags ma dang*/ phyi ma 'di bzung bskyil bzlog gsum sbrags ma ste/ bi bhu ti tsand+ra la sha wa ri pas dngos su gdams pa'i nye brgyud kyi man ngag go /de rnams kyi mthar gong du bshad pa'i 'bebs rnams gal che'o/ /de ltar na rjes dran gdams ngag can gyi lugs srol phal cher 'dus pa'i 'khrul 'khor nyi shu mon me brag kha ba grags pa seng ge dang*/ sron pa chos dpal bzang po la sogs pas sdom tshig tu mdzad pa'i lag len ji lta ba bzhin du bkod pa'o/ /de ltar na rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i lam la nye bar mkho ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyi lag len gsal byed 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas gab pa dang dkrugs pa med cing shin tu gsal bar sbyar ba'o/ / <mchan dang a gu rnams ni/ dpal 'dzam thang dgon gyi phyag len thub bstan 'gyur med rgya mtsho'i gsungs rgyun ltar dang*/
